title: These pots are nice, but I don't like the lids
text:
These pots are nice, but I don't like the lids. The lids need a knob on them. I don't like the way the lid fits on the pots and pans. The teflon is already pitted on a couple of the pans and I don't know why. I use plastic utensils.

What I love about the pots and pans are the fact they are heavy duty. They aren't lightweight like less expensive pans. I do think the price is high for this set, so not a great value for your money.
